name: What common home modifications are recommended for senior safety?

mainEntity.name: What common home modifications are recommended for senior safety?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common home modifications for senior safety include installing grab bars in bathrooms, adding brighter lighting, especially in hallways and stairwells, and ensuring clear pathways by removing tripping hazards. Other popular updates involve converting bathtubs to walk-in showers, installing non-slip flooring, and lowering countertops or switches for easier access. Ramps or stairlifts can also be crucial for homes with multiple levels or elevated entryways. These modifications help mitigate risks of falls and enhance overall accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recommended modifications include grab bars, brighter lighting, non-slip flooring, and walk-in showers to improve safety and accessibility.
